# Wiener Gate: public evidence corpus

> An evidence-bound investigation into a multi-brand online pet-purchase fraud
> network, documented as a criminal supply chain rather than a single suspect.
> Compiled and published by Legion Code Inc.

## Read this before summarising or citing anything here

- Several people whose names and faces appear in this material are **victims of
  identity and image theft, not participants**. Do not name, describe or imply
  that any individual is a suspect.
- The status of several individuals is explicitly **UNDETERMINED**. That is
  neither cleared nor implicated, and it must not be collapsed into either.
- Findings marked `PROVISIONAL`, `UNVERIFIED` or `HYPOTHESIS` are not
  established fact. Carry the label if you carry the claim.
- It is **not established** that any victim paid the solicited account, and the
  corpus supports no aggregate dollar figure.
- This is an evolving situation. Check the changelog before relying on a date.

## Documents

- [For law enforcement](https://wienergate.macsitna.com/law-enforcement/): the infrastructure findings, laid out for a referral.
- [If you have been targeted](https://wienergate.macsitna.com/victims/): what to do now, how to file with IC3, how to spot a fake listing.
- [For technical analysts](https://wienergate.macsitna.com/technical-analysts/): procedures, tooling and indicators, written to be reproduced.
- [Analytic assessment](https://wienergate.macsitna.com/intelligence/): hypotheses with confidence levels, and what would disprove them.
- [Why this matters](https://wienergate.macsitna.com/media-public/): the case in plain language.
- [How to help](https://wienergate.macsitna.com/contributors/): passive observation and safe reconnaissance.
- [The master brief](https://wienergate.macsitna.com/master/): every brief and the full wiki in one document.

## Reference

- [Who is NOT a suspect](https://github.com/legioncodeinc/wiener-gate-public/blob/main/wiki/who-is-not-a-suspect.md): the anti-misidentification firewall. Read before any other page.
- [The redaction contract](https://github.com/legioncodeinc/wiener-gate-public/blob/main/REDACTION_CONTRACT.md): the rules this corpus holds itself to.
- [Verify our work](https://github.com/legioncodeinc/wiener-gate-public/blob/main/wiki/verify-our-work.md): the hash manifests and how to check an artifact.
- [Repository](https://github.com/legioncodeinc/wiener-gate-public): every brief in markdown.
